paper_title: Knowledge Crosswords Geometric Knowledge Reasoning with Large Language   Models
caption: Problem distribution based on the correctness under the w/ knowledge and w/o knowledge settings using Zero-Shot.
model_annotation: This chart displays the distribution of problem correctness across three difficulty levels—easy, medium, and hard—under Zero-Shot conditions, with each pie chart segmented by four categories: N+K+ (teal), N−K+ (yellow), N−K− (orange), and N+K− (reddish-orange), as indicated by the shared legend. Each pie chart contains four slices, with the largest slice in the easy chart being N+K+ at 55.4%, followed by N−K+ at 38.3% and N+K− at 1.7%, with N−K− at 4.6%. The medium chart shows N+K+ at 58.8%, N−K+ at 35.4%, N+K− at 4.8%, and N−K− at 1.8%. The hard chart features N−K+ at 37.3%, N−K− at 37.9%, N+K− at 6.7%, and N+K+ at 18.1%. All slices are labeled with their percentage values and are visually arranged in descending order of size within each pie chart, with no slices appearing exploded or otherwise emphasized.
